title: BEACON Shipped-Locale Registry
description: Validates config/locales.json (ADR-030; FR-I18N-1/5/7/8; SPEC §3.5). The registry is the DATA half of the locale definition; src/config/locales.ts holds the TYPE half (LOCALE_IDS literal union) and a drift-guard test asserts the two agree exactly. Adding a language is: one messages/<id>.json catalog + one entry here + one id in LOCALE_IDS — no other source change (FR-I18N-7). The `id` pattern is also the SECURITY allowlist (NFR-F7): a locale id reaches a catalog file path, so it must never be a free-form string.

$comment.description: Human note; ignored by the loader.

defaultLocale.description: The fallback locale at every level. MUST be 'en': English is both the authored source catalog and the last rung of the fallback ladder (FR-I18N-2), so any other value would make a missing key unresolvable.

locales.description: Every shipped locale, in switcher display order. Order is meaningful: it is what a reader scans.

localeId.description: BCP-47 language tag, optionally with a script or region subtag (e.g. 'en', 'zh-Hans', 'pt-BR'). The restrictive pattern is deliberate — this value is interpolated into a catalog path, so no separators, dots, or traversal sequences are permitted (NFR-F7).

englishName.description: Name of the language in English — used in docs, a11y copy, and audit output.

nativeName.description: Endonym — what a speaker of the language calls it. This is what the switcher renders, because a reader who cannot read the current UI language searches for their OWN name for their language.

dir.description: Writing direction. Drives <html dir> and the logical-CSS layout. The map canvas, geographic axes, and basemap imagery NEVER mirror (ADR-030).

script.description: Lowercase ISO 15924-style script tag (latn, arab, deva, beng, cyrl, grek, hans). Selects the bundled font family and the unicode-range subset that must be shipped.

review.description: Translation provenance — an HONESTY field (Art. XV), not a workflow state. 'source' = authored in this language (exactly one locale may claim it: English). 'human' = human-reviewed translation. 'machine' = machine-translated and NOT yet reviewed, which MUST be disclosed in the catalog's _meta block and labeled in the UI while that locale is active (FR-I18N-5).

font.description: Bundled, self-hosted font family that covers this script. Never a CDN reference — the application must render correctly fully air-gapped (Art. XVI). Where a script's font cannot be shipped within the size budget, the value names the documented system-font stack instead, and the limitation is stated in SPEC 'Known limitations'.
